product.title: Chill Sans
product.body: Chill Sans wants text to have character. From bold softness to light airiness. The family opens up through its warm shapes and uninterrupted balance, making it a dedicated companion for endeavors where friendliness and sincerity are key. It can be both gentle and cheeky, embracing its curves effortlessly and helping the words it transforms come to life.
product.seo_title: Chill Sans • Sans Serif Font Family • Download Free Trials
product.seo_description: With its warm open shapes and an friendly rhythm, Chill Sans is a versatile geometric-humanist grotesque font family. Clean yet charming, it’s a perfect typeface for unique branding, logotypes, books, websites and advanced typography

brand.title: Chill Type
brand.body:
Nestled somewhere in Austria, between a chocolate factory and a fire station, lie the offices of Chill Type. Founded as an independent foundry in 2024 by Vedad Siljak, we strive to create original typefaces inspired by whatever tickles the imagination and makes the senses tingle. The gamut between transitional serif and cat food logo is a wide one that begs to be explored.

Our typefaces are designed with great attention to detail and built to be useful as well as satisfying to use. Nothing brings us more joy than doing quality work and getting that kerning just right.

If you would like to say hi, feel free to reach out via [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/chilltypeco) or [Email](mailto:hey@chilltype.com).
